usage:
usage: mcedge build <project-dir> [--target <engine-id>|all] [--no-gradle] [--probe|--profile]
       mcedge engines
       mcedge mcp <project-dir> [--allow-headless-runs]
projectWarnings: project has warnings (the build goes on):
unknownGameRule: game rule "{rule}" is not a Minecraft rule and no game_rule element has it as its ruleName or id (camelCase and snake_case both match); ignore this only when the rule comes from another mod
translatedStore: translated text stored by a server procedure: the server's language is used for every player, because {block} syncs the value to the clients; store the key (or the raw values) and translate where the text is shown, or show it with the translated message block
